metadata.prompt:
Subject: Editorial workspace showing structured SEO article planning on a large monitor
Context: A realistic content strategist desk with notes, page outline cards, and image prompt checklist
Composition: Wide hero image with the workspace centered and calm negative space for headline overlay
Realism constraints: natural screen glow; realistic desk materials; no impossible reflections
Avoid: floating holograms; unreadable text; distorted hands; brand logos
No logos, watermarks, or readable fake UI text unless explicitly requested.
metadata.alt: Content strategist planning a structured AI SEO Super Page workflow
metadata.caption: A Super Page pipeline separates planning, rewriting, image generation, and quality review.

qa.notes: Mock vector placeholder is acceptable for deterministic validation but should be replaced by a generated image later.

blocker: generate:mock does not call live image providers; run npm run generate:image:live for quota-spending image generation.
